title: Archived Cardamom Chai price
text: Cardamom Chai was priced at ₹99 per cup during the synthetic historical fixture period. This archived value must not answer a current-price question dated 2026-11-03 or later. See NK-FACTS-001#FACT-06 for the current approved price.

title: Cedar Cup Cardamom Chai price
text: Cedar Cup's Cardamom Chai is priced at ₹80 per cup. Cedar Cup is a separate fictional organisation. Its facts must not answer Nook & Kettle questions.
